notes:
{恐|おそ}ろしい is an i-adjective meaning frightening or terrible, stronger than ⟦{怖|こわ}い→怖い：00864_kowai⟧.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {恐|おそ}ろしく
- Noun form: ⟦{恐|おそ}ろしさ→恐ろしさ：28403_osoroshisa⟧ (terribleness)

INTENSIFIER USE:
{恐|おそ}ろしく + adjective/adverb means 'terribly, incredibly':
- {恐|おそ}ろしく⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧: terribly fast
- {恐|おそ}ろしく⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: incredibly expensive

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{怖|こわ}い→怖い：00864_kowai⟧: scary, afraid (more common in daily speech)
- ⟦{恐怖|きょうふ}→恐怖：02585_kyoufu⟧: fear, terror (noun)
- ⟦{物|もの}{凄|すご}い→物凄い：27844_monosugoi⟧: tremendous, incredible

NOTE:
In colloquial use, {恐|おそ}ろしい can express amazement at something extreme, not necessarily fear.
